description: For a user-requested plan opening, read get_checklist and get_expenses too; briefly summarize current dates, places, tasks and balances, then offer one contextual next step in the user's language. No identity is needed to read; never guess personal debts. After a write, just report that result instead of repeating the overview. Read the saved plan explicitly requested by the user. If the user's link is a bare /when, /where, /rsvp, /checklist or /splitwise URL, do NOT call this tool: explain it is a local draft and ask for its saved share link, even when a different plan was used earlier. Never replace a supplied link with the previous plan. Returns today's date in time_zone (UTC by default), title, event details, participants and their availability/RSVP, best dates, place votes and currency. Pass since (an earlier server_time) to also read changes.

include_all_dates.description: For calendar UI: return all dates within the existing bounded read budget, instead of the concise first 60 per person.

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.

since.description: Optional ISO timestamp (server_time from an earlier get_plan).

time_zone.description: User's IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Prague. Use when resolving tomorrow or other relative days; today defaults to UTC if omitted.

name: get_plan
title: Read a plan
